schema_event_storage_impacts.impact: Stream's Storage & Retention landmark projects these storage-owned families: legal hold (managed, suspends deletion + compaction), non-destructive compaction (receipts, append-only successor records, never rewrite closed seglog), quarantine, project/data deletion (irreversible, tombstone + receipt), encryption-at-rest, periodic test-restore. GUI is a projection only; it does not re-own storage key registration.

Candidate event families exercised by Stream ops: backup_performed, restore_point_created, settings_imported (with restore_point_ref + conflict_count), settings_rolled_back, storage_compacted (with receipt_ref + preserved_set), legal_hold_changed, storage_pressure_evaluated, artifact_cleaned, cleanup_performed (with dry_run_ref + evidence_retention_floor), search_index_rebuilt (with phase + failure_count). Provisional families; registry ownership stays with storage/event owners.

Stream respects durable / bounded-cache / discardable receipt classes. Backup/compaction/cleanup/import receipts are durable; index phase progress and web cache stats are bounded-cache; live stream frames are discardable.
Backup/restore/compaction/import-apply acquire the aggregate canonical-store lock; Stream's ObservableWork must show truthful wait phases when the lock is contended, never fake liveness.

slint_port_impacts.impact: Runtime Artifacts, History & Sessions, Containers/Images, GitHub Actions runs, and Source Control history/graph rows must use a virtualized Slint list model. Large repos produce many runs/images/commits; naive ListBox will jank. Use a model-backed proxy with windowed delegates.

Back Up Now / compaction / import-apply / index-rebuild progress is model-driven ObservableWork, not a property the view mutates directly. Slint binding reads a ProgressModel that the owner updates; view never invents phase text.

Landmark-river scroll must be portable: scroll position is a model field (active_landmark_id), and SubcategoryScrollspy both drives and reflects it. On deep link, set active_landmark_id then scroll; on user scroll, update active_landmark_id. Works across renderer backends (Skia/FemtoVG/software).
Scroll-linked highlight and ObservableOperation transitions must honor reduce-animations; themes (light/dark/glass/retro) must not break landmark contrast or receipt-link affordance.

Managers hydrate lazily and probes are bounded/cached/coalesced/ResourceGovernor-governed. The Settings Workspace must not block on opening all C4 managers at once; each landmark hydrates on near-scroll or on demand.

deferred_named_owners.insertion_contract: Stream reserves a Server landmark/region with human-language cards (Home Server Connected, Processing on this server, Clients N paired). Grammar: ManagerShell + ResourceCard + HealthSummary + ReceiptLink. Deep-link target reserved. NO backend state machine, no raw server catalog exposure. When Server_Backbone.md is authored it owns host identity, connection lifecycle, and receipts; Stream binds the reserved destinations.

Reserves a human-language 'Run Work' / execution-host destination (Automatic / Home Server / On this server). Home Server is default Execution Host when capability-compatible; native Windows/macOS/Linux, Docker, TrueNAS, Unraid, Kubernetes are execution-capable forms; WSL optional and does not replace native Windows. Stream binds grammar only; capability matching + host lifecycle owned by Server_Backbone.md.
Reserves a 'Clients' card (N paired) and client-pairing grammar. No client state machine in Stream; pairing/auth lifecycle owned by Server_Backbone.md.

Reserves 'Hosted On' / 'Project Files' human-language project cards. Project Sync, Project Move, and PM application/content update state machines are explicitly NOT implemented here. Stream binds the card grammar only; sync/move/hosting lifecycle owned by Server_Backbone.md + Release_Supply_Chain.md.

Reserves Remote Access / SSH-remote grammar for execution environments and container SSH remotes. SSH source/cert/credential realms are never exposed as raw config by default; human-language connection cards only. Lifecycle owned by Server_Backbone.md.

Reserves an Updates insertion point in the deferred Server region for PM app/content update flows. Stream does NOT implement update state machines; it binds the reserved shell grammar (status card + SetupFlowLauncher) to Release_Supply_Chain.md ownership. system.advanced.auto-update / catalog-updates / update-frequency inventory rows remain owned by Release_Supply_Chain.md.
